content: Testing non-deterministic LLM calls in R: use httptest2::with_mock_api() or vcr::use_cassette() to replay fixed provider responses. Test the grounding guard deterministically by feeding mock responses containing known values. Split into three layers: (1) deterministic diagnostics tests (no network), (2) guard tests with mocked HTTP, (3) provider smoke tests with skip_on_cran(). Never use temperature=0 as a substitute for mocking.
